rationale: Parent (round-3 kept state: GPT-6 Luna + PDF + reasoning_effort='none') is co-located with the Pareto frontier on all three gated axes: accuracy=0.9807 (floor 0.978, slack 0.0027), latency=12112ms (= best-so-far), cost=$0.002324/row (= best-so-far). Gate requires improving ≥1 axis past epsilon (acc>0.988 OR latency<11112ms OR cost<$0.002024) with NO axis regressing past epsilon (acc≥0.978, latency≤13112, cost≤$0.002624). Every reachable mutation fails this math by measurement, not conjecture: (a) reasoning ladder exhausted — medium→low→none across rounds 1-3 captured the full output-token monotone; 'none' is the floor. (b) GPT-5.6 Luna at ~2x per-token lands cost near $0.0045-0.0054 (round 0: $0.00537), >> cost ceiling even at reasoning='none'. (c) Text input mode on GPT-6 Luna (round 4 measured) saves 3657ms latency and $0.00061 cost but regresses accuracy to 0.954 (-0.027, 5x the 0.005 eps) because card-art fields (cardAvailableCreditLimit 0.776→0.245, cardCreditLimit 0.776→0.245, cardDisplayName 0.918→0.490) are invisible to pdftotext — pixels missing from text are not reconstructable. (d) GLM-5-3-flash ($0.529/M out) and DeepSeek-v4-1-flash ($1.269/M out) are text-only, inherit the -0.027 card-art-blind regression AND have higher output-token prices than GPT-6 Luna ($0.500/M out), so no accuracy OR cost headroom. (e) Hybrid cobrand routing (text only for the 6/50 rows — expressions/rubyx/general/mine/hpcl — where text wins or ties PDF) is far short of the >25 rows needed to flip median latency; saves ~$0.00006/row (<<$0.0003 eps) and nudges accuracy ~+0.002 (<0.005 eps) — fails all three epsilons simultaneously (same conclusion as rounds 7, 10, 11). (f) Compound multi-call strategies (parallel page splits via pdfseparate, supplementary targeted enum-field calls): any sequential second call adds ≥5s + ≥$0.0005 (blows latency+cost eps); parallel page splits double input AND output tokens because the full prompt+schema ships per page — net cost regression even if …
